mapper.select:
select hmrb.bp_id, hbm.bp_eng_name, hbm.bp_name, hbm.bp_name as bp_name_n, hmr.marketing_report_id, hmr.marketing_report_number, hbmr.bp_type, hbt.description as bp_type_n, hbm.bp_class
from hls_marketing_report hmr, hls_marketing_report_bp hmrb, hls_bp_master hbm, hls_bp_type hbt, hls_bp_master_role hbmr
hmrb.marketing_report_id = hmr.marketing_report_id and hmrb.bp_id = hbm.bp_id
and hmr.from_project = 'N' and hbmr.bp_id = hbm.bp_id and hbmr.bp_type = hbt.bp_type and hmrb.bp_type = hbt.bp_type
and hmr.marketing_report_id = #{marketingReportId}
mapper.update: update HLS_CREDIT_LINE_CHANCE_BP set credit_amount_used=#{creditAmountUsed} where bp_id=#{bpId} AND chance_id=#{chanceId}
mapper.select:
SELECT hclcb.chance_bp_id, hclcb.bp_id, hbm.bp_name , hbm.bp_code, hclcb.bp_type, ( SELECT sc.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v sc WHERE sc.CODE = 'BP.BP_MASTER_ROLE' AND sc.code_value = hclcb.bp_type ) bp_type_n, hbm.economic_indu_classify, ( SELECT t.description FROM hls_stat_class t WHERE t.class_usage = 'BIZ_PARTNER' AND t.enabled_flag = 'Y' AND to_char( t.CLASS_ID ) = hbm.economic_indu_classify ) economic_indu_classify_n, hbm.group_companies, hclcb.note FROM HLS_CREDIT_LINE_CHANCE_BP hclcb INNER JOIN hls_bp_master hbm ON hclcb.bp_id = hbm.bp_id
hclcb.chance_id = #{chanceId}
